news.headline: CrowdStrike CEO Competes on Model Pricing: “Ours Is Like Three Cents”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz said a general remediation task costs about $10 on the best frontier cyber model and about three cents on CrowdStrike’s own model. That cost gap lets CrowdStrike undercut the AI labs on price and still keep the roughly 75% gross margin it has held for the last three fiscal years.
